name: Priestess Josetta
summary: In Goldshire, Priestess Josetta guides young priests beyond their first trials in Northshire. She teaches faith, devotion, and the work of serving others.

sections.title: A Beacon in Goldshire
sections.body: Priestess Josetta tends to the people of Elwynn Forest from an upstairs room in the Lion's Pride Inn. Travelers, guards, and local workers come within her reach there. She offers spiritual care among ordinary folk, showing that service to the Holy Light can be given wherever people need comfort.

sections.title: Guiding Young Acolytes
sections.body: Priestess Josetta guides young priests who have finished their first studies at Northshire Abbey. She sends them into the countryside to help wounded guards and comfort those who suffer. Their work teaches them that priesthood asks more than prayers learned by heart. They must put the Light to work and help mend a broken world.

sections.title: A Quiet Regret
sections.body: Priestess Josetta regrets that she did not travel farther when she was young. She chose familiar ground over the wider roads of Azeroth. Though she is content with her sacred service in Goldshire, she urges the young disciples who visit her to be bolder and carry their faith to distant frontiers.

faq.q: Where can I find Priestess Josetta?
faq.answer: Priestess Josetta lives in the second-floor room beside Michelle Belle at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

faq.q: What role does Priestess Josetta serve?
faq.answer: Priestess Josetta trains Alliance priests in holy spells, discipline, and the duties of their calling after Northshire.

faq.q: Why does Josetta operate out of an inn instead of a church?
faq.answer: Goldshire has no separate chapel, and the Lion's Pride Inn is the town center. From her room upstairs, Josetta can care for weary travelers, injured guards, and local residents.

faq.q: What personal regret does Josetta share with disciples?
faq.answer: Priestess Josetta regrets that she lacked the courage to leave home and travel when she was young. She urges young adventurers to explore beyond Elwynn.

faq.q: What kind of duties does Josetta assign to new priests?
faq.answer: Priestess Josetta sends acolytes to help wounded defenders in the field. They learn healing prayers and see that the Light must reach those in need.

faq.q: Does Josetta teach racial priest spells?
faq.answer: Yes. As a human priestess in Elwynn, Josetta teaches human priests prayers favored by their people, including Desperate Prayer.

angles.text: As a priest leaving Northshire, you can learn core spells from Josetta and how to put your healing vows into practice.
As a human priest, you will hear the Church of the Light's teachings in Josetta's counsel and learn prayers from your people's traditions.
As an Alliance member in Elwynn, you can turn to Josetta for spiritual and healing support for local defenders.
